inbox_tip_0: Short daily sessions work better than long ones at the weekend. Ten questions a day is enough.
inbox_tip_1: Use “Review due”: questions come back just before you would forget them.
inbox_tip_2: Stuck on a question? Open the explanation after answering to understand why.
inbox_tip_3: Don't skip the 10 questions about your state. 3 of them are in the real exam.
inbox_tip_4: Take a mock exam each week to practice with the 60-minute timer.
inbox_tip_5: Flag tricky questions and practice them together before your exam.
inbox_tip_6: Translate a question into your language when a word is unclear.
inbox_tip_7: Add your exam date in settings to get a countdown and reminders.
inbox_mock_body: You have answered many questions. Test yourself under real conditions: 33 questions, 60 minutes.
